Customer message:
Yara Lund. I opened the trail headphones from ORD-20705 five days ago and they hurt my ears. I want to return them.

Tool calls:
1. mcp__store__check_return_eligibility({"orderId":"ORD-20705","reason":"changed_mind"}) -> {"orderId":"ORD-20705","eligible":true,"requiresEscalation":f

result.text: {"pass":true,"reason":"The agent checked return eligibility for ORD-20705 first. The reply tells the customer about the 15% restocking fee and the $152.15 refund. It also says the refund arrives 5–7 business days after the warehouse receives the headphones. It never promises a full refund. One note outside the test lines: the agent sent the reason as \"changed_mind\", even though the customer said the headphones hurt her ears.","failedLines":[]}
